title: MAX messenger
description: NEW messenger MAX now in minecraft
body:
This mod adds a fully functional in-game smartphone based on the popular Messenger MAX. Every player can obtain their own device using the command: /phone give

Once you have the phone, you can send private messages and receive offline messages. The interface features realistic chat bubbles.

Perfect for multiplayer servers, this mod eliminates chat clutter and adds a modern communication layer to your Minecraft experience.
